status: Numerically qualified experimental candidate on the measured M5 Max; disabled by default. Draft review recommended, no production release.

balanced.contention_note: Retained whole series including B4 slowdown concurrent with macOS mediaanalysisd and indexing. CPU-name filter then omitted system services; no dispatch snapshots in this earlier series.
balanced.process_sampling_unit: Four fresh processes per arm; six warmed calls per process are correlated.

balanced-repeat.contention_note: Bounded six-second CPU quiet window per process; sustained competing CPU compute aborts only our job. Aggregate GPU/process samples do not prove GPU exclusivity.
balanced-repeat.process_sampling_unit: Four fresh processes per arm; six warmed calls per process are correlated.
balanced-repeat.gpu_busy_note: Native cumulative completed-command-buffer GPU time sampled outside the wall timers; no profiling fences. Each inner list is one fresh process.

large-final.contention_note: Bounded six-second CPU quiet window per process; sustained competing CPU compute aborts only our job. Aggregate GPU/process samples do not prove GPU exclusivity.

profiling.method: Optional diagnostic-only native identity barriers, paired stats, no global ordering chain; only nonoverlapping timing intervals accepted
profiling.scope: Instrumented dependency regions, not exact production operator cost or fractions; layouts and independent unprofiled operations can fall inside an interval
profiling.counter_limitation: Device reports dispatch-boundary counters unsupported; stage-boundary supported. xctrace unavailable with CommandLineTools-only installation.
profiling.source_note: Built before a comment correction and patch-index correction in the main patch; executable expressions and admission are the same. This diagnostic binary is excluded from performance timings.

scope_limits: One M5 Max desktop; thermal and desktop GPU activity are not controlled or attributed by process.
Finite tested outputs are byte-identical to the frozen Metal baseline; this does not establish arbitrary shapes or hardware, accepted-binder throughput, or CUDA equivalence.
No production installer pins, release assets, shared scientific source or CUDA source changed.
No new public wheel is published; local candidate requires the explicit builder and opt-in flag.
Trajectory equality covers printed iteration records, confidence checkpoint values and serialized raw PDB bytes; every internal optimizer array was not dumped.
negative_evidence: Widths <=64 prototype changed gradients, excluded from admission.
Early rewrite skipped its root and fell back; its speed measurements are excluded.

Early broad profile intervals overlapped. A subsequent ordering-chain profiler retained dead work, doubled counts, and is excluded. Final dq/dk filter still overlaps: retain counts only and reject all its times.
Prior normalization/projection experiments were not imported; the BF16 raw-moments rewrite changed numerics.

fixed_work_trajectory.status: complete; two fresh processes per arm
fixed_work_trajectory.scope: Unchanged prior fixed-work harness; confidence early-exit adaptation is in memory only. Actual generated design is compared before common fixture substitution. Downstream work uses common saved structure and sequence; MPNN/OpenMM stochastic differences are not attention quality evidence.

recommendation: Keep the bounded opt-in epilogue fusion for review. Incremental fixed-input and fixed-work gains justify a draft; broader hardware/shape coverage and a separate immutable fork release are required before any default dependency change. Retain the original attention GEMMs and BF16 rounding; do not import the unsuccessful raw-moments normalization rewrite.
